title: Human Resource Management Affecting Organizational Commitment Of The Staff Of The Credit Union League Of Thailand Limited / การบริหารทรัพยากรมนุษย์ที่มีผลต่อความผูกพันในองค์กรของเจ้าหน้าที่ชุมนุมสหกรณ์เครดิตยูเนี่ยนแห่งประเทศไทย จำกัด
author: Worrakul Sreesodsai; วรกุล ศรีสดใส; Songserm Homglin; ส่งเสริม หอมกลิ่น; Sukhothai Thammathirat Open University; songserm.hom@stou.ac.th
category: เศรษฐกิจและการจัดการ
abstract: The research aimed to study 1) human resource management process and 2) organizational culture and work motivation. 3) Organizational commitment 4) Analysis of factors affecting organizational commitment and 5) Problems and recommendations for human resource management affecting organizational commitment of staff of the Credit Union League of Thailand Limited. This research was survey research. For the population that was used in the research was the Credit Union League of Thailand Limited, 2025, with totaling 123 people, studied from the entire population. The Instrument for this research was a questionnaire. Statistics was used for data analysis included frequency, percentage, maximum, minimum values, mean, standard deviation, multiple regression analysis, and content analysis.The research results found that 1) the overall human resource management process was at a medium level (average 3.38). 2) Organizational culture and motivation in working.
